financial_series.notes: IFRS 16 (from 2019): operating leases are capitalised as right-of-use assets (RMB 10,847m) and lease liabilities (RMB 11,707m). Depreciation in note 42(a) includes right-of-use asset depreciation. financial_series_method.delta_nwc_basis: Cash-flow-statement reconciliation basis: delta_nwc = -(cfs working-capital cash inflow) - change in current income tax liabilities. The balance-sheet direct change is NOT used, because the 2015 to 2016 reclassification of customer deposits (RMB 54,108m, FY2016 report note 38) and the simultaneous disappearance of restricted cash (RMB 54,731m at 2015 year-end to RMB 750m at 2016 year-end) is a non-cash presentation change; the balance-sheet basis would misstate 2016 delta_nwc as +29,491 and FCFF_2016 as about 4,900.
financial_series_method.balance_sheet_nwc_definition: Balance-sheet NWC = (inventories + accounts receivable + prepayments, deposits and other assets, current) - (accounts payable + other payables and accruals + current income tax liabilities + other tax liabilities + deferred revenue). Cash, term deposits, restricted cash, other financial assets and financial assets at FVTPL are excluded from current assets; borrowings, notes payable, lease liabilities and other financial liabilities are excluded from current liabilities. Verified: reproduces the recorded 2015 (-90,411), 2016 (-60,920) and 2017 (-97,338) values exactly. The 2015 other-payables balance included customer deposits RMB 54,108m, reclassified out in 2016.
financial_series_method.ifrs_16_leases: From FY2019 the group applies IFRS 16: operating leases are capitalised as right-of-use assets (FY2019 RMB 10,847m) and lease liabilities (FY2019 RMB 11,707m). Depreciation in the cash-flow reconciliation includes right-of-use asset depreciation. Per project-owner ruling (IFRS 16 lease principal adjustment, supplement): lease principal repayments (FY2019 RMB 2,400m; cash flow statement, financing activities, 'Principal elements of lease payments') are included in organic CapEx, restoring comparability of FCFF with the IAS 17 years FY2010-FY2018. SOTP and WACC are unchanged: lease liabilities are deducted at book value in SOTP and included in WACC debt D; right-of-use assets are core operating assets and are not counted in SOTP. Residual overlap (lease principal deducted from FCFF and the lease liability also deducted in SOTP) is about 0.1% of enterprise value, disclosed and accepted as immaterial.
financial_series_method.fintech_classification: Financial technology and enterprise services are pre-classified as core operating business; they are not classified as non-operating assets and are not separately added in SOTP.
financial_series_method.fx: All financial_series and SOTP amounts are recorded in the annual reports reporting currency (CNY, RMB million). HKD conversion at the CFETS fiscal-year-end HKD/CNY mid-rate is done in fx_conversion; see fx_conversion for the rates, formula and source; original RMB fields are retained unchanged.
financial_series_method.listed_equity_market_value_sensitivity: Not computable from the annual reports alone (no per-holding share counts or formation-date closing prices disclosed); recorded as a gap and not estimated.
financial_series_method.rounding_rule: NOPAT and FCFF are computed from the exact tax_sum/pbt_sum ratio and rounded to the nearest RMB million; FY2012 NOPAT is 14,949*(1-7,046/46,209)=12,669.56, rounded to 12,670, and FCFF_2012 is 13,670.

sotp.fx_note: Converted to HKD at the FY2019 year-end CFETS HKD/CNY mid-rate 0.89578 (observation date 2019-12-31); see fx_conversion
sotp.listed_equity_market_value_sensitivity: Not computable from annual reports alone: the balance sheet does not disclose per-holding share counts and formation-date closing prices for listed equity investments; recorded as a gap, not estimated, and not written back to the main SOTP input.
sotp.duplicate_counting_check: Interest income, dividend income, disposal gains and fair-value gains on financial assets at FVTPL and other financial instruments were removed from EBIT; investee impairment was added back; share of associates and joint ventures profit is below operating profit and not in EBIT; FVOCI fair-value movements go through other comprehensive income, not profit or loss.
sotp.sources: FY2019 annual report balance sheet pp.138-140; note 35 pp.246-247 (borrowings); note 36 pp.247-248 (notes payable); lease liabilities per the balance sheet (IFRS 16 on-balance-sheet lease liabilities, non-current RMB 8,428m and current RMB 3,279m).
sotp.notes: Lease liabilities (RMB 11,707m) are the IFRS 16 on-balance-sheet lease liabilities, deducted at book value; right-of-use assets (RMB 10,847m) are core operating assets and are not counted in SOTP. Long-term payables (content authorisation etc.) are not interest-bearing debt and are excluded from debt. FVTPL non-current (RMB 128,822m) and FVOCI (RMB 81,721m) are counted as equity investments at book value; the current FVTPL balance (RMB 7,114m) is treasury investments and is counted in non-operating financial assets with other financial assets (RMB 375m).
